couplings.reason: suites spawn the CLI without importing it, so the import graph has no edge to src/cli
stats-failures and memory-writers use DatabaseSync directly against the memory schema; memory-writers is also declared here per ch-04 task 5.1
content guards read agents, skills, commands, templates, docs and src files as text without importing them
cli suite copies source/assets and reads package.json, README and agent frontmatter as text
delta-spec-structure scans active aspec/changes deltas as text without importing them
memory-fixtures reads JSON fixtures and refs-root under test/fixtures without importing them
memory-writers spawns the writer fixture by path, so a fixture change leaves no edge in the import graph
test-selection enumerates test/*.test.js, reads the real manifest and spawns the consumer script without importing them
agent-model-coherence reads agent and profile sources plus src files as text
model-catalog reads agents and profile frontmatter as text
adapters-frontmatter reads agent frontmatter as text
linter-config reads the flat config, package.json, PRODUCT.md, the publish workflow and scans src/test as text
